Educational mission with dosimeter and biology payloads.
Description

Education mission designed to teach, train and inspire the next generation of STEM professionals, as well as provide educational opportunities for underrepresented groups in STEM-related fields.

IRVINE04 includes a dosimeter that detects beta and gamma radiation and a Bio-Module that houses a growth experiment on Sulfurovum sp.—a bacteria that naturally occurs in undersea hydrothermal vents.
